title: The Deep Border
author: Sebastian Nystrom
blurb: Dominic Voss, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
